links.evidence: Dr. Demis Hassabis, a former researcher at University College London, founded DeepMind in 2010. DeepMind develops AlphaFold 2, a next-generation protein structure prediction model. AlphaFold 2 uses the Evoformer architecture to process multiple sequence alignments efficiently.

Dr. Demis Hassabis, a former researcher at University College London, founded DeepMind in 2010. DeepMind develops AlphaFold 2, a next-generation protein structure prediction model. AlphaFold 2 uses the Evoformer architecture to process multiple sequence alignments efficiently.
Alphabet Inc funded both DeepMind and Isomorphic Labs during their corporate expansions. To support large-scale biomedical runs, AlphaFold 2 was trained on the Google Cloud TPUv3 Supercluster.

John Jumper co-invented the Evoformer architecture. John Jumper leads the Protein Structure Team in London. Recently, the Protein Structure Team partnered with Isomorphic Labs to accelerate computational drug discovery.

Isomorphic Labs uses the AlphaFold 2 model to simulate molecular binding pathways. Through these simulations, Isomorphic Labs advances Eli Lilly Oncology Targets, a novel small-molecule compound. Eli Lilly Oncology Targets effectively address Solid Tumors in preclinical research.
